findings.title: PUT /api/settings/skills-library grants unattended fleet-wide agent-filesystem write, gated only by role
findings.recurring_class: assert_admin is a role gate, not a human gate (trinity-ops-agent#232 -> trinity#1644 -> trinity#1816)
findings.evidence: assert_admin(current_user) only; dependencies.py:740 rejects connector principals and checks role == 'admin'. An agent-scoped MCP key resolves to its owner carrying the owner's role.
findings.exploit: Prompt-injected agent arranges for the configured library to carry attacker-authored skills (mechanism REDACTED — depends on finding 2, still open) -> PUT /settings/skills-library {auto_sync_enabled, auto_reinject_enabled} passes assert_admin -> scheduled loop pulls the library -> fleet sweep writes SKILL.md into every running agent's ~/.claude/skills/ and rewrites each CLAUDE.md -> every agent reads attacker instructions on every subsequent turn, persistently and unattended. Step 3 is what this fix breaks.
findings.impact: Privilege escalation plus fleet-wide lateral movement and persistent prompt injection.
findings.recommendation: Add reject_agent_principal(current_user) before assert_admin on the PUT. GET may remain role-only.
findings.remediation_status: FIXED — reject_agent_principal added to the PUT (routers/settings.py), regression tests in tests/unit/test_ent236_skills_lifecycle.py::TestAutomationSwitchIsHumanOnly
